blocks.head: alt The user is not near any device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device and the key is the cloud key of account UserY
alt The user is near the device

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' DeviceX 
= < UserX | ('near' : DeviceX , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : DeviceX , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' DeviceX 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < DeviceX | ('buttonPressed' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' DeviceX 
= < DeviceX | ('buttonPressed' : true , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : DeviceX , ..) > < DeviceX | ('buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : nils , ...) > < cloudA | (UserY : ('key' : Key , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'sendKey' DeviceX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('near' : DeviceX , ..) > < DeviceX | ('buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ...) > < cloudA | (UserY : ('key' : Key , ....) , .....) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : DeviceX , ..) > < DeviceX | ('key' : Key , ...) > $ UserX 'discover' DeviceX 
= < UserX | ('near' : DeviceX , ..) > < DeviceX | ('key' : Key , ...) > $ DeviceX 'bind' cloudA | (Key) .

eq < DeviceX | ('key' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ..) > < cloudA | (UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ....) > $ DeviceX 'bind' cloudA | (Key) 
= < DeviceX | ('key' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ..) > < cloudA | (UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, deviceB) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .
